knowledge.wuxingxiantu.scroll_hint: Study once to supplement your alchemy experience.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.scroll_limit: Scrolls share a half-rank XP allowance. Promotion still requires works, item quality and realm.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.scroll_blocked: Learn alchemy first. No scroll is consumed if this rank has no available inheritance allowance.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.scroll_studied: Alchemy experience +%s. Pass the Crafts assessment to advance.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.title: Myriad Compendium
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.index_intro: Select a chapter. Pages refresh for the current reader.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.refresh_hint: Use this book to refresh your personal knowledge.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.herbs_intro: Public species guide. Years accrue on growing plants, never in inventory. Species and growing conditions limit medicinal potential.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.alchemy_intro: Known formulas show current recipe data. Scrolls grant XP; formulas and manuals grant knowledge.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.alchemy_locked: Read an alchemy manual first. This book does not unlock formulas.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.locked_formula: Unknown formula. Study its formula or manual.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.formula_variants: %s recipe variants. See the furnace for full ingredients.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.no_recipe: No recipe for this formula in the current data pack.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.refining_intro: %s forging recipes are loaded. The existing forge checks materials, aura and fire. Crafts assessments control advancement.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.arts_intro: Only your learned arts reveal their text. Reading grants no ability.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.locked_art: Unknown art. Study its manual first.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.locked_divine: Unknown divine art. Study its inheritance first.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.fa_t: Become a giant, gaining health, protection, reach and damage. Slower movement; ongoing aura cost.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.ta_g: Follow the seven-star steps to change clear weather, rain and storms.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.yuan: Project a flying soul through terrain. Aura upkeep rises with distance from your body.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.yi_h: Leave your body and possess a creature as a soul. Release possession or recall the art.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.qi_s: Transform into creatures recorded through possession. Switch forms or recall.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.jin_: Ride a swift cloud. Cast again to recall.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.ri_y: Briefly halt nearby non-player entities while the caster can move and attack.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.divine_brief.tian: Craft known formulas and available forging recipes from your inventory. Realm, fire, material and aura checks remain.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.treasures_intro: Treasure access uses your realm; talisman text uses your actual knowledge.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.banner_intro: The Human Emperor Banner stores souls and manages deployment, recall and transfer. Realm and soul-power costs apply.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.locked_talisman: Study the Wan Fa Gui Zong fragment to learn talisman knowledge.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.talisman_intro: You know talisman runes. Use the engraving and drawing tables; materials and quality requirements still apply.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.swords_intro: Texts reflect your learned sword techniques. Sword tier, nurture stage, insight and aura requirements remain.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.locked_sword: Unknown technique. Meet its conditions and learn it through sword nurturing.
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.sword_limits:
Sword tier ≥%1$s
Nurture stage ≥%2$s
Learning insight %3$s
knowledge.wuxingxiantu.handheld_only: Read this personal compendium in hand. Any copy on the lectern is returned to your inventory.
